name: Al Kahfi Mosque Platform
description: A responsive mosque information platform for prayer schedules, daily prayers, hadith collections, and community donations.
overview: Al Kahfi Mosque Platform brings essential worship information into one accessible website, helping the community check prayer times, browse daily prayers, explore hadith collections, and access donation information.
challenge: Worship information was spread across different sources.
Prayer schedules and religious content needed to remain clear and easy to scan.
The experience had to work comfortably across desktop and mobile devices.
solution: Created a focused information architecture for prayer times, prayers, and hadith.
Designed reusable content cards and readable data layouts.
Built responsive interfaces with clear navigation between key mosque services.
outcome: Centralized essential mosque information in one digital platform.
Made prayer schedules and religious content easier to access.
Delivered a consistent interface for the Al Kahfi community.

name: Xue in Mandarin Learning Platform
description: A responsive language learning platform for Chinese language learners.
overview: Has been use for more 100 users, xue in Mandarin Learning Platform brings essential language learning resources into one accessible website, helping learners improve their Chinese proficiency through interactive 4 lessons and practice exercises.
challenge: Language learning materials were scattered across different platforms.
Users needed a structured approach to progress through lessons.
The platform had to be engaging and easy to use on both desktop and mobile devices.
solution: Developed a comprehensive curriculum with progressive difficulty levels.
Created an intuitive user interface for lesson navigation and progress tracking.
Implemented responsive design principles for optimal performance on all devices.
outcome: Provided a centralized hub for Chinese language learning resources.
Enhanced user engagement through interactive learning features.
Delivered a seamless experience for learners across different devices.

name: Bintan Drift Tour Agent
description: A responsive company profile website designed to strengthen Bintan Drift Tour Agent's digital presence and showcase its travel services and destinations.
overview: Bintan Drift Tour Agent is a company profile website developed to establish a stronger digital presence for the business and provide potential customers with clear information about its travel services and destinations. The website focuses on presenting the brand professionally, improving service discoverability, and creating a more engaging experience for visitors across different devices.
challenge: Presenting travel services and destination information in a clear and visually engaging way without overwhelming visitors.
Creating a responsive experience that remains consistent across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Building a professional digital presence that reflects the company's identity and helps increase trust among potential customers.
Delivering the website within a short development timeline while maintaining code quality, performance, and visual consistency.
solution: Developed the website using Next.js and TypeScript to provide a maintainable, scalable, and performance-oriented frontend architecture.
Built reusable and responsive UI components with Tailwind CSS to maintain consistent styling throughout the website.
Structured destination and service content to help visitors quickly discover relevant information and understand the company's offerings.
Implemented subtle animations and transitions using Motion to create a more engaging experience without affecting usability.
Optimized layouts and components for different screen sizes to provide a consistent browsing experience across devices.
outcome: Delivered a modern and responsive company profile website within the planned two-week development period.
Established a dedicated digital presence that allows potential customers to explore Bintan Drift Tour Agent's services and destinations more easily.
Improved the overall presentation of the company's brand through a structured, professional, and visually engaging interface.
Created a reusable frontend structure that can support future content, destinations, and service expansions.

name: Bengkel Koding LMS
description: A streamlined LMS experience for course delivery, student progress tracking, and academic operations with a clean responsive interface.
overview: Bengkel Koding LMS is a web platform concept for managing courses, student progress, learning materials, and academic operations from one responsive interface.
challenge: Students and administrators needed different workflows in one platform.
Course, progress, and content screens had to feel connected.
The interface needed to avoid overwhelming users with too many actions.
solution: Planned a clear information architecture for courses and learning progress.
Created role-aware UI patterns for student and admin experiences.
outcome: Created a scalable LMS concept for academic workflows.
Improved clarity across course delivery and progress tracking.
Kept the interface responsive and easier to maintain.

name: Fokusin
description: A gamified Pomodoro app that turns focused time into collectible egg and character rewards, helping users build consistent productivity habits.
overview: Fokusin is a SwiftUI-based Pomodoro app designed to make deep work more engaging through progressive rewards. As users accumulate focus time, they unlock collectible eggs and characters that visualize their progress. I handled the product end to end, from interface design and MVVM architecture to SwiftData persistence, responsive iPhone and iPad layouts, and App Store readiness.
challenge: Traditional focus timers often provide little motivation beyond completing a session.
Timer history, statistics, and collectible progress needed to remain consistent between app launches.
The interface had to adapt comfortably to different iPhone and iPad screen sizes while keeping the timer easy to read.
solution: Built preset and custom Pomodoro timers with animated progress and clear session states.
Structured the application with MVVM and used SwiftData for persistent sessions, statistics, and unlock progress.
Created a progressive egg and character reward system based on total accumulated focus time.
Designed responsive SwiftUI layouts and prepared the product for App Store distribution.
outcome: Delivered an end-to-end productivity experience that connects focused work with visible rewards.
Made long-term progress easier to understand through history, statistics, and collectible states.
Created a maintainable native architecture that supports future timers, characters, and progression features.

name: Broceries
description: A smart grocery companion that recommends personalized shopping lists, tracks household stock, and alerts users before items run low or expire.
overview: Broceries is a lightweight grocery and household inventory app that recommends personalized shopping lists based on a user's history and current needs. It tracks item availability at home, warns when stock is running low or approaching expiration, and uses CoreLocation to help users find nearby stores and markets. The experience extends across Apple devices, including Apple Watch, while keeping personal inventory data securely on-device.
challenge: Household inventory changes frequently and is difficult to track without adding friction to everyday routines.
Shopping recommendations needed to reflect both purchase history and the user's current stock levels.
Low-stock, expiration, location, and cross-device features had to feel useful without making the app heavy or intrusive.
solution: Created a personalized shopping-list flow informed by item history and household needs.
Built inventory tracking for item availability, stock levels, and expiration dates.
Added local notifications for products that are running low or nearing expiration.
Used CoreLocation for nearby store discovery and extended essential information to Apple Watch.
outcome: Combined grocery planning and household inventory into one focused native experience.
Helped reduce forgotten purchases and potential food waste through timely stock and expiration reminders.
Kept the product lightweight and privacy-conscious while supporting connected Apple devices.

name: Orenji
description: An AI-assisted basketball posture coach that evaluates shooting form in real time and provides immediate visual, haptic, and Apple Watch feedback.
overview: Orenji is an iOS basketball training app built with SwiftUI and Vision to evaluate shooting posture from a live camera feed or recorded video. It analyzes important body angles across the shoulders, elbows, hips, and knees, then translates the results into immediate visual and haptic guidance. Apple Watch support keeps posture status visible on the user's wrist and provides a tap whenever their form needs correction.
challenge: Basketball players often need immediate, understandable feedback to correct shooting form during practice.
Raw pose landmarks and joint angles had to be translated into useful posture guidance instead of overwhelming technical data.
Camera analysis, interface updates, haptics, and Apple Watch feedback needed to work together with minimal interruption.
solution: Used Vision pose detection to analyze shoulder, elbow, hip, and knee angles from live or recorded footage.
Designed a real-time SwiftUI feedback layer that clearly communicates posture status and areas for correction.
Added haptic cues so players can react without continuously watching the screen.
Extended posture status and correction alerts to Apple Watch for more accessible feedback during training.
outcome: Created an accessible training experience that turns pose-analysis data into actionable shooting feedback.
Enabled athletes to review both live and recorded movement while receiving immediate correction cues.
Expanded the coaching experience beyond the phone through synchronized visual and wrist-based feedback.
highlights: Live camera and recorded video input

name: Morro
description: An AI-powered living-abroad simulator that helps first-timers explore the realities of living in Japan through personalized scenarios and interactive conversations.
overview: Morro is an iOS simulation experience for first-timers who are considering living in Japan. Instead of relying only on second-hand stories or idealized expectations, users can explore realistic situations based on their preferences and circumstances before making a major decision. Apple Intelligence and the OpenAI API power interactive conversations, while MapKit, widgets, and Live Activities keep location-aware scenarios and active experiences accessible throughout the journey.
challenge: People planning to live abroad often face too much fragmented information and struggle to identify what is relevant to their own situation.
Second-hand experiences and idealized expectations can make it difficult to form a realistic picture of daily life in Japan.
The simulation needed to feel personal and interactive while keeping scenario progress and recommendations easy to revisit.
solution: Designed preference-based simulations that help users explore realistic living situations and compare options before moving abroad.
Combined Apple Intelligence with the OpenAI API to create interactive AI conversations that respond to the user's choices and scenario context.
Used SwiftData to persist user preferences, simulation progress, conversation context, and saved decisions on-device.
Integrated MapKit to connect scenarios with relevant places and location context across Japan.
Built WidgetKit and Live Activity experiences so users can follow active simulations and key updates outside the main app.
outcome: Created a more grounded way for first-time movers to understand the practical experience of living in Japan.
Turned broad relocation information into personalized scenarios and interactive decision support.
Delivered a native iOS foundation that connects AI conversations, location context, persistent progress, widgets, and Live Activities.
